mapper.update: UPDATE faq SET delete_yn = 'Y' WHERE faq_no = #{faqNo}
UPDATE faq SET sort_order = sort_order + 1 WHERE sort_order >= #{fromOrder} AND delete_yn = 'N'

MERGE INTO faq f USING ( SELECT faq_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sort_order, faq_no) AS new_order FROM faq WHERE delete_yn = 'N' ) t ON (f.faq_no = t.faq_no) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET f.sort_order = t.new_order
